disputes.call: Both versions lead to the same move: accept the balcony meditation in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save. The counter in this guide counts to 18, and the three extra spots are the safe margin.
disputes.title: How many meditations does the trophy need?

versions.label: A
versions.text: 18 meditation spots across 10 places — meditate with both Jason and Lucia at each spot.

versions.label: B
versions.text: The 100% checklist stops at 15 meditations — only 15 of the 18 count toward 100%.

disputes.call: Start every stranger chain the moment it appears; the eight that count are the ones this guide lists, and the counter is the trophy list's tracker.
disputes.title: Which 8 stranger strands count?

versions.label: A
versions.text: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed counting strands; more strangers are yet to be discovered.

versions.label: B
versions.text: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count as strangers — no guide lists all eight qualifiers.

disputes.call: Unconfirmed — do not chase a method. If the Prologue store shows up in your play, try it; otherwise leave this trophy until a guide pins it down.
disputes.title: What triggers Bad Luck, I Guess?

versions.label: A
versions.text: Believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.

versions.label: B
versions.text: No guide gives a confirmed trigger — the trophy is listed as unknown.

disputes.call: Unconfirmed — do not farm a method that is only a belief. Kicking enemies from a motorcycle is the guess; the trophy may need something else entirely.
disputes.title: What triggers Ten Pin?

versions.label: A
versions.text: Believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle.

versions.label: B
versions.text: No guide gives a confirmed trigger — the trophy is listed as unknown.

disputes.call: Try the PowerPyx method first — the blue Banshee in the south Vice City showroom, Key Cloner ready. If it does not pop, the trigger is not pinned down and the trophy stays on the watch list.
disputes.title: Is Capital Offense confirmed?

versions.label: A
versions.text: Full method given: steal the specific blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it through the window.

versions.label: B
versions.text: Other lists mark the trigger unconfirmed — no second guide repeats the method.

disputes.call: Hunt every animal Bret requests as Jason; the trophy pops on the right one. The exact animal is not confirmed anywhere.
disputes.title: Which animal unlocks Fair Game?

versions.label: A
versions.text: Bret's questline: hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him as Jason.

versions.label: B
versions.text: Which animal exactly unlocks the trophy is still unconfirmed.

disputes.call: Say 'the final mission' and name no chapter for #7. The chapter number is not pinned down by the guides.
disputes.title: Which chapter is the final mission?

versions.label: A
versions.text: The final mission is described with the same wording as the end of Chapter 4, 'Starting From Zero'.

versions.label: B
versions.text: Chapter 5 holds its own mission, 'Operation Savage Glory', so the final mission's chapter is not cleanly pinned down.

disputes.call: Fly the whole map until the fog is gone. The counter that matters is the fog, not the area count.
disputes.title: All 52 areas, or the whole map?

versions.label: A
versions.text: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida.

versions.label: B
versions.text: Fully unfog the whole map — best done by plane over every black-fog area.

disputes.call: Protect the one that is certain: do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation and keep a Chapter 1 save. The rest are windows, not locks.
disputes.title: How many trophies can be missed?

versions.label: A
versions.text: Potentially 1 — Positive Mental Attitude is the only one flagged possibly missable.

versions.label: B
versions.text: Push Square says no missable is known; TechWiser warns five stranger chains have story windows.

disputes.call: Plan for 200 to 250 hours. The story is 60 to 80; the 100% grind is the variable.
disputes.title: How long is the platinum?

versions.label: A
versions.text: About 200 hours in total, difficulty 4 out of 10, one playthrough.

versions.label: B
versions.text: 250 or more hours in total.

disputes.call: Any 250 stunts count toward the trophy; the 100% list wants 300. Under the Bridges are the quickest.
disputes.title: How many stunts exist?

versions.label: A
versions.text: 397 stunts in total: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights, 25 Base Jumps.

versions.label: B
versions.text: The trophy needs any 250; the 100% checklist needs 300.

disputes.call: Scan everything you see. The named categories add to 89; the rest are No Flusher Tags.
disputes.title: Where do 100 WAiNK scans come from?

versions.label: A
versions.text: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures — plus No Flusher Tags.

versions.label: B
versions.text: More than 100 scannable locations exist; any 100 count.

disputes.call: The trophy counts any 100 vehicles; the 100% list counts 200 of the 277 base models. Scan base models first.
disputes.title: How many vehicles are there?

versions.label: A
versions.text: 557 vehicles at launch — cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes.

versions.label: B
versions.text: 277 base-model vehicles; the 100% list needs 200 of them scanned.

disputes.call: Only the 8 purchasable garages count, at $160,000 total. The 4 story garages do not.
disputes.title: How many garages must you buy?

versions.label: A
versions.text: 8 purchasable garages; only those 8 are needed for the trophy.

versions.label: B
versions.text: 8 purchasable plus 4 story-related garages exist — 12 in total.

disputes.call: Follow the checklist's lines, not its name. Most lines are partial by design.
disputes.title: Is 100% really 100%?

versions.label: A
versions.text: The checklist is called 100% Completion and opens after the story.

versions.label: B
versions.text: It is closer to 60% true completion — most requirements are partial.

disputes.call: Collect all 18 card-set locations; the sets complete as you go. The guide lists every location.
disputes.title: Which locations belong to which card set?

versions.label: A
versions.text: 18 card-set locations in total across Leonida.

versions.label: B
versions.text: The three sets split the 18 locations; no single list agrees on every split.

disputes.call: One operation per gang pops the trophy; all 39 are needed for 100%. Rob one per gang early.
disputes.title: How many gang operations?

versions.label: A
versions.text: 39 Illegal Gang Operations across 9 gangs.

versions.label: B
versions.text: The trophy needs one operation belonging to each gang — 9 in total.

disputes.call: Do the 50 easiest challenges; the hardest 10 can stay undone. Save this trophy for late.
disputes.title: How many challenges count?

versions.label: A
versions.text: 80 challenges exist; only 50 are needed for the trophy.

versions.label: B
versions.text: The 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80.

disputes.call: Two bank vaults cover the $250,000. Launder the marked bills as you rob them.
disputes.title: How fast can you launder $250,000?

versions.label: A
versions.text: Up to $205,000 in marked bills from a single bank vault.

versions.label: B
versions.text: $250,000 total, cumulative — no need to bring it all at once.

disputes.call: Rob 5 vaults for the trophy, then the last 3 during cleanup. All 8 are needed for 100%.
disputes.title: Five vaults or eight?

versions.label: A
versions.text: 5 bank vaults robbed and escaped for the trophy.

versions.label: B
versions.text: 8 Large Bank Jobs in total; all 8 are needed for 100%.

disputes.call: The Chapter 4 mission vault counts as the armored truck. Do not chase trucks separately.
disputes.title: Does a bank vault count as an armored truck?

versions.label: A
versions.text: Robbing a bank vault in the Chapter 4 mission counts as robbing an armored truck — you tail the truck to the bank.

versions.label: B
versions.text: The standalone method: block a truck, plant a sticky bomb on its back door, blow it up, escape.

disputes.call: Trust the in-game tracker under Progress, then Activities. It counts 9 types.
disputes.title: Which 9 activity types count?

versions.label: A
versions.text: 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, video games, races, stunts.

versions.label: B
versions.text: Lists name the types differently — some split races into three, some count fewer.

disputes.call: Gold every challenge at all 12 ranges. The count is 42 golds in total.
disputes.title: How many shooting golds?

versions.label: A
versions.text: 12 Shooting Range locations, 42 gold medals in total.

versions.label: B
versions.text: Each range holds several challenges; the gold count per range is not agreed everywhere.

disputes.call: Win one race at each of the 14 locations. Three races run at most locations.
disputes.title: How many drone races per location?

versions.label: A
versions.text: 14 locations, 42 drone races in total.

versions.label: B
versions.text: The trophy needs a win at every location — one win each, not all 42.
